name: {{ .service }} · oldest message < {{ .max_age_s }} s
description: Share of time the oldest waiting message is younger than {{ .max_age_s }} s. Owner: {{ .team }}.

customSli.indicator:
timeseries age = max(<oldest-message-age metric>), filter:{ service.name == "{{ .service }}" }
| fieldsAdd sli = 100 * iCollectArray(if(age[] < {{ .max_age_s }}, 1, else: 0))
